scientific_integrity: The all-vertex complete-outbreak theorem has an explicit proof and independently constructed exact finite-state checks. The full mathematical scope is derived analytically, not inferred from finite experiments. Historical-priority assessment is limited to inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Assumes a finite undirected tree, one seed, iid positive finite infectious lifetimes, independent equal-rate Poisson contacts and no reinfection. Complete infection means ever infected, not simultaneous or by deadline. Models with cycles, heterogeneous transmission, multiple sources or alternative dynamics are excluded. Unindexed predecessor results remain possible.
title: Full-outbreak source ranking depends only on degree on every homogeneous tree
